hypothesis: The residual V148 regression is concentrated in singleton overrides that barely clear at least one frozen V147 evidence gate. Requiring an additional 3 dB of clearance on the weakest gate should fail closed on ambiguous singleton edits while preserving only high-confidence overrides.

singleFrozenConstructionPolicy.name: accepted-baseline-plus-v148-singletons-nearest-gate-at-least-3db
singleFrozenConstructionPolicy.copyV148RowOnlyWhen: event is one of the 106 V148 singleton edits AND phase-a nearestGateExcessDb >= 3.0

rationaleFor3dB: 3 dB is a simple pre-score confidence margin applied uniformly to the weakest of the already-frozen V147 gates; it is not selected from Gold/reference performance and produces no subgroup-specific tuning.
scoreBoundary: Construction is reference-free. Any Gold score must occur only after the exact constructed candidate is persisted and a separate one-use scorer is frozen to its exact identities.
